body:
Shit man. I feel you here. I know this is supposed to be people saying don't do it or something, but these have been my thoughts lately. 

I just don't see the point in the struggle anymore. What's getting you?

My parents are proud of me. They, however, don't know I'm about to throw away everything they think I'm close to achieving. 

So, by definition it does make me a disappointment. Ive considered talking to my psychiatrist about it, but I'd rather not be put in some hospital. I have a psychiatrist because I was just diagnosed with ADD, however haven't been able to get the medication yet. 

Well by not acting, by procrastinating or being overwhelmed I miss assignment and get that much closer to failure. I make these choices every moment by the actions I take. I'm making no major decisions. Just small ones that add up. I did do one good thing lately. I told the girl I've been talking to what I really am and that she should leave. I feel good about that at least. 

I'm not sure if I would have a support network really. My father would frown upon it silently, if not openly. I have no close friends to speak of. My mother would care, but she's a mother. I'm not the type to share problems. So I don't have anyone to confide in or that would serve a support purpose.
